items.claim: typescript@7.0.2 is the current latest stable release; 7.1.0-dev.* are unreleased prereleases

TS7 compiles this package with 0 errors once @types/node and types:['node'] are added -- both omissions caused real build failures, fixed by running the build and reading the actual errors, not assumed in advance
9/9 tests pass, all reading REAL .ai/ and audit/eais/ files (no mocks) -- e.g. loadTruth() asserts clinic.domain === https://dentalsmilesavers.com against the actual persisted canonical.json
eais context correctly achieves 93.8% byte reduction for a domain-scoped task after the stopword fix (was polluted before the fix, captured and fixed live)
eais gate reports overall: NO-GO, blocking: ACCESSIBILITY -- reading the real, already-known, deliberately-deferred blocker rather than a fabricated or optimistic status
